name: AttachmentDropZone
label: Attachment drop zone
description: A wrapper that makes a whole surface a file drop target, with an outlined overlay while files hover over it.

props.name: onFilesSelected
props.description: Fires with the files dropped anywhere on the zone.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the zone reacting to drags; its children behave as if it were not there.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon above the overlay's headline: a Material Symbol name, or any
custom element. Pass `null` for none.

props.name: label
props.description: Headline of the overlay shown while files are dragged over the zone.

props.name: hint
props.description: Second line of the overlay: what may be dropped, e.g. accepted types and limits.

props.name: children
props.description: The surface that accepts drops: a chat panel, a thread and its composer.
